analyst_view.overall: Málaga are bottom with 5 points and still looking for a first league win under Juanfran Funes, so they need to go for this game at La Rosaleda. Racing (José Alberto) lost 0-3 to Real Madrid and have taken no points away from home. Racing are without Álvaro Mantilla (cruciate ligament) and key attacker Andrés Martín (hamstring), and Manu Hernando (illness) and Maguette Gueye (muscle) are doubts. Málaga are missing Ochoa and Lobete, Juan Cruz is doubtful, and Pablo Martínez is managing plantar fasciitis.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. Racing's poor away defence and Málaga's need to win point to goals, but losing Andrés Martín takes a big piece out of Racing's attack, so the two effects roughly cancel.

corners.text: The numbers say 13.2 corners, already very high. Málaga chasing a first win at home should push for set pieces, but that is largely priced into the model, and there is no news to move it further.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards. A bottom-of-the-table side in a must-win home game can make for a tense match, but no referee has been named yet, and the news gives no clear direction.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.9 shots. Málaga should attack with Adrián Niño, Dani Lorenzo and Larrubia, and Racing remain open away from home, but Racing will be short of Andrés Martín's output. The model's figure looks fair.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target. Both defences have let through plenty of chances, which the model already accounts for, and the team news does not clearly change the picture.
